target.candidate_revision: working tree with hair visual-semantics data, visual-only render-review support, tests, and five-arm artifacts

goal.request: Apply researched hairstyle vocabulary to the visual-semantic candidate pack and independently test five different complex reference-informed image concepts against saved-pixel gates.

evidence.claim: The referenced ChatGPT conversation retained the user's hairstyle-research question but no assistant answer, so absent prior keyword output was not invented.

Nine approved source records support factorized hair axes, cut structure and disconnection, braid and loc topology, cultural non-inference, balayage placement, optical highlight confounds, and wet-bundle mechanics.
The dictionary, 81-profile and 477-term visual index, 6,909-entry semantic index, 49 focused tests, 2,070 contradiction samples, 24 holdouts, and 112 scene-expression routes pass.

All five independently frozen v6 packs contain exactly one assigned hard hair profile, preserve five distinct profile-owned evidence fields, attach the exact reference bytes, and pass composed and runtime audits.
The hime-cut render passes long rear mass, visible step, and bilateral context but fails blunt-panel and generic-layer confound gates.
The cornrow render passes all five scalp-row topology gates.
The twin-tail render fails all five strict gates because only one genuine tie point and gathered bundle are visible.
The balayage render passes all five distributed-ribbon placement gates.
The wet/damp render passes all five volume, bundling, adherence, coherence, and gloss-confound gates.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A requested hair term is represented by its complete observable structure, placement, or temporary state in one saved image, while declared substitute appearances fail.

invariants.statement: Every hard hair profile owns five observable component groups, five distinct prompt-evidence fields, five exact saved-pixel gates, and explicit confound substitutes.
Cut structure, gathered arrangement, braid topology, color placement, and wet finish remain separate candidate owners and cannot substitute for one another.
Hair labels describe visible hair only and do not infer nationality, ethnicity, personality, value, or biometric identity; locs use a neutral runtime label.

flexible_dimensions: hair length or texture only where the profile permits variation

mismatches.source_state: The prompt requires two dense blunt cheek-to-jaw panels plus a long rear mass and disconnected step.
mismatches.render_state: The shorter sections curve and taper, leaving a rounded bob-over-long-hair interpretation available.

mismatches.axis: two tie points and two gathered bundles
mismatches.source_state: The prompt requires visible left and right tie points, two trailing bundles, and root-to-tie convergence on both sides.
mismatches.render_state: Only one side forms a definite tie point and bundle; the opposite side remains loose hair.

hypotheses.statement: Separating cut, topology, arrangement, color placement, and temporary finish into five-component contracts prevents label-only or single-cue false passes.
hypotheses.falsifier: A declared substitute such as loose tendrils, one ponytail, dry gloss, an ombre field, or free braids passes the complete hard profile.

hypotheses.statement: Repeating the dense horizontal endpoint geometry at face-side panel tips and using a slightly more frontal hair-readable crop will reduce bob-over-long-hair substitutions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unrelated hime renders keep tapered or curved panel endpoints despite strengthened endpoint geometry.

hypotheses.statement: A more frontal or rear-biased head view with both tie points placed outside the face silhouette will improve bilateral gathered-topology survival.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unrelated twin-tail renders still collapse to one ponytail or loose side hair while both attachments are explicitly staged.

intervention.general_rule: Represent hair requests as axis-owned observable component contracts with exact/contextual hard activation, optional embedding discovery, distinct evidence phrases, thumbnail/native pixel gates, and explicit substitute failures.
intervention.generalization_basis: The seven profiles span cut structure, braid and cord topology, gathered arrangement, color placement, and moisture state rather than being tuned to one portrait or one scene.

decision.rationale: The research ledger, data contracts, indexes, routing tests, candidate packs, composed prompts, runtime requests, provenance, and three unrelated complex renders pass. Broad render-fidelity promotion is blocked because the hime-cut side-panel endpoints remain substitutable by a rounded bob layer and the twin-tail topology collapses to one definite tied side. User aesthetic acceptance is not yet available.
